metrics.note: Sealed before/after reproduction for base-data#43's response to Codex CHANGES_REQUESTED (a coverage/freshness guard that can certify stale or unavailable ratio inputs as healthy is worse than no guard). Two P1 fixes reproduced from controlled synthetic fixtures (no live-tree read, no network, no production path touched): (1) per-concept provenance freshness -- a shares-backed ratio recovered by carry-forward correctly retains its OLDER contributing filing's age (101d) and fails a tight 60d freshness bound, rather than inheriting the newest filing's misleadingly-fresh timestamp; (2) dual coverage denominator -- a 1-of-10-priced universe reports a misleading perfect 1.0 on the legacy priced-relative number while the new universe-denominator (0.10) and prerequisite-price-coverage (0.10) numbers correctly flag the axis unhealthy. Also documents the test_fetchers_lift root-cause fix (a fragile parents[2]-relative path heuristic could find a wrong same-named directory and report a false byte-mismatch FAILURE instead of a clean skip; fixed via a subrepos.lock.json marker check + RENQUANT_UMBRELLA_PATH override).
